say:1:1861101001:0.text: With a waxing moon hanging overhead in the clear dark sky, you enjoy a stroll through the streets of Novaris.
say:1:1861101001:0.source_cn: 天朗气清的上弦月时分，你独自悠闲漫步在诺珐斯街头。
say:1:1861101001:0.male: With a waxing moon hanging overhead in the clear dark sky, you enjoy a stroll through the streets of Novaris.
say:1:1861101001:0.female: With a waxing moon hanging overhead in the clear dark sky, you enjoy a stroll through the streets of Novaris.

say:2:1861101002:1.text: The people of Novaris have put the lockdown behind them, along with the sudden collapse of the Adamant Syndicate's building. The city is at peace again.
say:2:1861101002:1.source_cn: 无论是全城戒严，还是黑金商会的离奇倒塌，都已被人们所遗...

say:3:1861101003:1.text: Novaris has finally broken free from Bantus' control. Although the threat still looms, you decide to enjoy the peace while it lasts.
say:3:1861101003:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道这样的时光会持续到何时，班题斯面对脱离掌控的...
say:3:1861101003:1.male: Novaris has finally broken free from Bantus' control. Although the threat still looms, you decide to enjoy the peace while it lasts.
say:3:1861101003:1.female: Novaris has finally broken free from Bantus' control. Although the threat still looms, you decide to enjoy the peace while it lasts.

say:4:1861101004:1.text: Suddenly, a shrill scream suddenly cuts through the air.
say:4:1861101004:1.source_cn: 就在此时，远处却传来了一声不和谐的尖叫。

say:7:1861101005:1.text: Mommy, it was a pumpkin spirit! I swear I saw it at the docks just now!
say:7:1861101005:1.source_cn: 妈妈！是南瓜恶灵！我刚刚真的在码头看到了南瓜恶灵！

say:8:1861101006:1.source_cn: 好可怕、好可怕的南瓜恶灵！

say:9:1861101007:1.text: Alright, alright, I hear you. How about we head back? I'm sure there are no spirits waiting for us at home.
say:9:1861101007:1.source_cn: 好，好，码头有恶灵，我们回家好不好？家里总没有恶灵了吧？

say:10:1861101008:1.text: *Crying* That pumpkin was moving... then, it just popped its head out of a crate to scare me!
say:10:1861101008:1.source_cn: 呜呜……那东西会动，还会从货箱里探出脑袋吓人！

say:11:1861101009:1.text: Oh, my poor darling... Maybe you were just imagining things...
say:11:1861101009:1.source_cn: 你也真是的，都已经是大孩子了，还这么相信这些……

say:13:1861101010:1.text: The Graveborn mother takes her daughter by the hand and hurries past you, while you can't stop thinking about what the girl just said.
say:13:1861101010:1.source_cn: 亡灵母亲拉着孩子的手从你身边匆匆经过，孩子口中童真的话...
say:13:1861101010:1.male: The Graveborn mother takes her daughter by the hand and hurries past you, while you can't stop thinking about what the girl just said.
say:13:1861101010:1.female: The Graveborn mother takes her daughter by the hand and hurries past you, while you can't stop thinking about what the girl just said.

say:14:1861101011:0.text: Is there really a pumpkin spirit lurking around the docks, or was the girl just imagining things?
say:14:1861101011:0.source_cn: 码头真的出现了南瓜恶灵吗？还是说，是孩子的想象力在作祟？

say:15:1861101012:1.text: Just the possibility of it is enough to concern you. You decide to head straight to the docks and see for yourself.
say:15:1861101012:1.source_cn: 码头、南瓜、恶灵……这几个词连在一起，听起来实在难以让...
say:15:1861101012:1.male: Just the possibility of it is enough to concern you. You decide to head straight to the docks and see for yourself.
say:15:1861101012:1.female: Just the possibility of it is enough to concern you. You decide to head straight to the docks and see for yourself.
